verdict.rationale: Scheduled send and undo-send are fair questions for an email client, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents basic sending: creating and sending new emails, creating drafts, and sending existing drafts. Nothing in the pack mentions send-later scheduling or an undo-send grace window, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can schedule an email to send later and undo a send within a grace window
